status: No definite functional findings in frozen five-file player-clumsy delta
observations: NPC body-dynamics implementation and humanoid component are untouched.
Landing chance and side selection use an instance-private seeded FRandomStream; gameplay/story random sources are not consumed.
Landed reads impact velocity before Super::Landed; installed CharacterMovementComponent::ProcessLanded invokes callback before SetPostLandedPhysics, preserving downward impact velocity.
Movement root, capsule, combat logic and gait speed caps remain authoritative; new physicality applies only to the player mesh.

Tick removes its previous rotation and translation contribution before applying the new one. Freeze/dead/unpossessed state and detected displacement >=200cm cancel new transient physicality; pause leaves game-time animation unchanged.
test_limitations: No builds, tests, Unreal sessions or GPU work run by this reviewer. Author focused5/5 receipt is reported rather than independently reproduced; final full suite is pending.

New unit tests exercise private-stream repeatability/chance, threshold rejection, pause/cooldown/recovery/freeze, bounded gait, and Cancel; integration deterministically exercises an actual qualifying Landed callback and low-hop bound.

Native rendered foot placement/mesh clipping, low-frame-rate visual cadence, and actual warp/freeze cancellation need final acceptance; tests do not directly exercise actor-level warp/death/unpossession during an active stumble.

Warp cancellation uses the existing >=200cm observed-displacement heuristic; smaller transform changes are not identified as teleports. No concrete gameplay regression from that limitation was established.
